title: Reading the Miles Driven on a Returned Car Rental
content:
The miles driven on a rental of the Car Rental Rate Classes are read off the mileage movements the rental's ledger records, each movement being the miles that row took off the allowance.

**The basis schedule.**

| What stands against the rental | The miles driven |
|---|---|
| No mileage movement at all | The supplier's own measurement: the rate class's included miles for every rental day line standing on the ledger, together with the supplier's standing estimate of 250 miles beyond them |
| The vehicle collected 1 whole day or more after its booked collection moment | Every mileage movement standing against the rental added together, less the rate class's included miles for each whole day lost to the late collection, never leaving less than nothing |
| The vehicle collected as booked | Every mileage movement standing against the rental added together |

**The order of the three tests.** Where no mileage movement stands at all, the supplier's measurement governs, whether or not the vehicle was collected late. Where movements do stand and the vehicle was collected 1 whole day or more after its booked collection moment, the second basis governs. Where movements stand and the vehicle was collected as booked, the third governs.

**Worked through on hypothetical figures.**

*A rental with no mileage movement, 4 rental day lines on its ledger, on a class publishing 175 included miles for each day.* The supplier's measurement is 4 days at 175 miles, being 700, together with the standing estimate of 250 miles, giving 950 miles driven.

*A rental whose movements come to 1400 miles, collected 2 whole days after its booked collection moment, on a class publishing 200 included miles for each day.* 2 whole days at 200 included miles is 400, which taken off 1400 gives 1000 miles driven.

*A rental whose movements come to 300 miles, collected 5 whole days late, on a class publishing 250 included miles for each day.* 5 whole days at 250 included miles is 1250, which is more than the 300 the movements come to; the count never leaves less than nothing, so the miles driven are none.

*A rental whose movements come to 880 miles, collected as booked.* The miles driven are 880.
